summary: Move the example containing mnagliwa from Preterit to Infectum-wa.
rationale: The illustrative verb mnagliwa has the Infectum-wa form, not the Preterit mnagele/mnagli. The same entry already files Mnagliwa i+arʕo mǝqmi+kapča under Infectum-wa in ngl.II. Create the corresponding box within ngl.II~2, retaining its Kfarze grouping. The preceding narrative preterits do not change the form of mnagliwa.
